Hi Ari / Megan,

Thanks again for the time earlier. Attached is a short Q3 export and a one-pager cost-to-serve summary that maps your current token mix to our proposed staged extension. In short: your inference peak last week and a consistent evening batch pattern are the two drivers we expect to push you into the next tranche in ~6–8 weeks if usage keeps growing at the current pace.

What we’re asking for: a 6-month staged extension that adds a small reserved corridor now (to lock price + burst credits) and a planned uplift at month 3 if you hit the defined usage thresholds. That reduces your unit cost now and prevents unpredictable overage spikes during product launches. I’ve outlined the thresholds and quick ROI bullets in the attached PDF.

Proposed next steps:
- Can you confirm procurement timing (PO window) and whether legal needs a redline before we send a DocuSign?
- If procurement can sign within 2 weeks, we’ll lock current pricing and provide a one-month burst credit as a goodwill buffer.

Attachments: Q3-usage-export.csv, cost-to-serve-summary.pdf

Thanks — happy to hop on a short 20-minute call if you want to walk the numbers.

Ari — good questions. Quick answers and an ROI sketch inline.

On burst credits: yes — the one-month goodwill burst credit we’re offering will absorb eligible production spikes for covered tokens. If the spike exceeds the credit, overage pricing applies; we’ll provide a post-spike reconciliation report and recommend a temporary uplift cadence to avoid surprise billing. We can also exempt the specific rollout window if you provide the freeze dates in writing (that’s standard).

Month-3 trigger flexibility: we can add a freeze window clause to the staged extension: if you declare a product freeze in writing 7 days before the window, the trigger will be paused for that period.

ROI sketch (illustrative):
- Current blended unit cost: $0.0018 per token (Q3 mix)
- Staged extension (reserve + corridor) blended: $0.00135 per token
- Expected token runrate at month 3 if growth continues: +32% from baseline
- Estimated monthly savings vs on-demand over the 6-month term: ~$18k–$23k (dependent on mix)

If that ROI looks reasonable we’ll draft the extension with the freeze clause and send to legal + procurement. I’ll attach the short motion doc to the DocuSign packet.

—Ben
